correctness.rationale: For every t,L>=1, N=L+t, the equal-row t-Young facets are complements of the L+1 consecutive t-windows and reversal maps facet F_k to F_{L-k}. Alexander dual of binary words without a run of t ones provides signed reversal Lefschetz via invariant palindromes. Half-word rational generating function (1-(-z)^(c+1))/(1+(-1)^t z^(t+1)), c=floor((t-1)/2) for even N or floor(t/2) for odd N, produces tilde Lambda=(-1)^(q+1) when L=(t+1)q+r with r=0 or1 and zero for r>=2. By cited nonequivariant S^{2q+r-1} theorem when r=0,1, the integral homology action is (-1)^(q+r). Averaging and barycentric subdivision give the claimed rational quotient homology; fixed-space Euler characteristic follows simplicial Lefschetz. Independent exact facet and signed augmented face checks passed 71 (t,L) pairs with t=1..6, L=1..12, N<=17; unrestricted conclusion uses explicit half-word derivation.
residual_risks: The all-parameter conclusion requires the reconstructed symbolic proof, not just bounded computations.
